lines.text: Many learners say: I was born in May 5.
Better: I was born on May 5.
Use on with a day and in with a month.
On! I was born on May 5.

data.why: Use on with a day and in with a month.

native.tip: 日付（日にち）には on。月だけなら in May。
native.caption: “I was born in May 5.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語は「5月5日に」と全部「に」なので in と on を混同しがちです。“I was born on May 5.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“on”。“I was born on May 5.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: On for the date. If it's just the month, it's in May.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I was born in May 5.” 😅 With a day, use on. The natural way is “I was born on May 5.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
